title: Chapter 833
text:
You have used the ability [Bold Explorer] on [Spacetime Amber]!

You have received the following information …

Everything in front of his eyes suddenly shattered, turning into fragments that fluttered in the air. His field of vision abruptly pulled far away, flying out of the galaxy and out of the Star Field. The stars shone brilliantly as the time passed. It was as if the Spacetime Amber had become a small boat, carrying him against the river of time and seeing the illusions of the past.

The next moment, it was as if he was falling. His vision was pulled closer, and the pieces of things reassembled in front of him, forming a person.

A video was played before his eyes. This person was on a planet, surrounded by countless enemies, and in the sky were fleets that were fighting. This person waved his hand and unleashed the ability to freeze time and space, freezing countless spaceships and Supers.

Han Xiaoxin understood that the person in the image was the Primordial One who formed the Spacetime Amber. This image was a part of the Spacetime Amber's past.

Is this ability giving me information by letting me see some illusions with my own eyes? It's quite similar to the effect of the Destiny's Child Character Summon Card, Han Xiaoxin thought.

Very soon, this Primordial One encountered a strong enemy. The battle image was automatically fast-forwarded. The process was blurry, and the details of the battle were omitted. The result was quickly shown. This Primordial One's consciousness was heavily damaged, and his soul was disintegrating. He was on the verge of death.

His other Beyond Grade A partner rushed over and retreated while fighting.

This time, this Primordial One whose consciousness was already blurred suddenly grabbed his partner's shoulder.

"I'm hopeless. Don't let my body fall into the hands of the enemy."

"Okay."

His partner's expression could not be seen through the armor. He decisively pressed down on this Primordial One's body and released his ability.

He let go of his defense and did not resist at all. His body crystallized at a visible speed, gradually shrinking into a palm-sized crystal and being thrown into the universe by his partner.

At this time, the image suddenly stopped. Han Xiao regained his senses and thought about it.

Hmm, although this is information that I knew long ago, if I didn't know, this would be equivalent to revealing the origin of the Spacetime Amber, which is relatively important information. The effect of this ability is not bad.

Han Xiao nodded to himself. Such an effect was suitable for unearthing hidden elements, and it could be used repeatedly on the same target. The information obtained each time should be different. If he used it frequently, there was an 80% chance that he could piece together all the information about the unknown object.

As for the negative effect of decreasing 60% Luck for 14 days, Han Xiao directly ignored it. Anyway, it was already 1. No matter how low it was, it wouldn't become a negative number. A dead pig wasn't afraid of boiling water.

Since the test results were not wrong, Han Xiao was prepared to use it on the wormhole data EsGod wanted after the cooldown was over. If he could not figure it out in one try, he would use it a few more times.

At this moment, a notification popped up on the interface, interrupting Han Xiao's thoughts.

You have triggered the Hidden Chain Mission [Legacy of the Primordial Ones — Spacetime Freezer].

Mission Introduction: Through some means, you learned that the Spacetime Amber was originally the remains of a Beyond Grade A Super. He was one of the Primordial Ones, 'Spacetime Freezer'. You have obtained his legacy. If you can complete his last wish, you will have a deeper understanding of the Spacetime Amber.

First Round Mission Requirements: Find out the will of the Spacetime Freezer.

Mission Reward: + 1 Soul Connection to the Spacetime Amber.

“？？？”

Han Xiao's face was filled with question marks.

What the hell is this mission? I've never even heard of it before!

"How was this hidden mission triggered … Oh, I get it." Han Xiao was surprised for a while but soon understood.

Although he knew the origin of the Spacetime Amber long ago, his personal memory did not affect the judgment of the interface at all. Only the information he obtained through his own actions would be recognized by the interface as fulfilling the prerequisite of the hidden mission.

The fragment of the origin of the Spacetime Amber that he obtained using [Bold Explorer] was the trigger for the mission.

In his previous life, no player had obtained the Spacetime Amber, so naturally, no one would know about this mission. He was the first person to trigger this mission.

As for the Soul Connection, Han Xiao knew what it was. It was commonly seen in the Mage and Psychic classes, and it could be understood as the affinity for a specific item. For example, the higher the Soul Connection a character had with an item, the more powerful the item would be, and the easier it would be to control it.

There was a living example in front of him. Sisko had controlled the Evolution Cube for so long that he had left a deep psychic imprint on the Evolution Cube. Furthermore, he could receive feedback from the Evolution Cube to strengthen his psychic power. This was because Sisko had a very high Soul Connection with the Evolution Cube, which was similar to the concept of refining magic equipment.

In his previous life, this function was only available to the players in the later versions. Only some special equipment or items had the concept of Soul Connection, but it was not absolute. For example, if a player had an ordinary item every day, it was possible to activate the Soul Connection.

"I'm not a Psychic or a Mage, so I don't know when I'll be able to form a Soul Connection with this thing. This mission has helped me skip the most difficult step. In another sense, the Spacetime Amber is the remains of the Primordial One. Completing his last wish will increase the Soul Connection, which might be equivalent to the recognition of the remains. Haha."

Spacetime Amber: Current Soul Connection: 0/5

With such a reward, Han Xiao was also very interested in this mission.

Although the Primordial Ones had existed for too long, as the first batch of Beyond Grade As in the universe, their information was still quite detailed. Many organizations were keen to study them, and Spacetime Freezer was not a nobody. It was very easy to obtain his information.

As for Spacetime Freezer's dying wish, Han Xiao was not worried that he would not be able to find it. According to the way the interface determined, he did not really need to study Spacetime Freezer's life. As long as he did the act of browsing Spacetime Freezer's information, the interface should judge that he had completed the requirement and automatically give him the next mission requirement.

After getting Philip to search for information on the internet, Han Xiao did not stay idle either. He started to build a simple control device for the Spacetime Amber.

As long as he had a Soul Connection, not only would he be able to receive attribute feedback from Universal Treasures like Sisko, but he should also be able to control the Spacetime Amber directly with his mind. However, he had not received the reward yet. He still needed mechanical equipment to help him use the Spacetime Amber.

Han Xiao completed the construction very quickly.

At this time, the Spacetime Amber was wrapped in a black spherical mechanical device. This device could activate the energy of the Spacetime Amber and be controlled by Han Xiao's mind. At the same time, it also had the functions of a hovering guard, such as flying, releasing shields, and so on.

Han Xiaoxin made the Spacetime Amber float and activate the device.

Gudu!

A small hole appeared on the spherical device. The next moment, invisible energy shot out from the hole and started to change the properties of a small area of space. The area of influence slowly expanded. When Han Xiao cut off the energy output of the Spacetime Amber, the changed space was frozen and turned into a solid amber.

"The output of the Spacetime Amber seems to be unable to be adjusted. The speed of creating amber is not fast, and it's constant. At this speed, it will take a few minutes to create an amber that can cover a two-meter-tall creature. Furthermore, the changed spacetime will only be fixed into amber when the energy output is cut off."

After thinking about it, Han Xiao summoned Psionic Prime out to test it. Very soon, he obtained all kinds of test results.

After Psionic Prime was completely wrapped up, Psionic Prime could not move, and his signals were cut off. He could not communicate with the outside world, and Philip could not give him any orders.

Han Xiao also tried to only wrap a part of Psionic Prime's body, such as his knees and not his calves and thighs, to see if he could cut off his control over his limbs. However, this attempt failed. It seemed that during the solidification process, the edges of the frozen spacetime had to be unobstructed. If there was any physical obstruction, the amber would not be able to form … This situation was a bit like blowing bubbles.

"Therefore, if I want to freeze a target, I can only wrap it up completely …"

Han Xiao stroked his chin and had an idea. Since the Spacetime Amber could block all kinds of energy and deflect energy attacks, it could be used as a special external armor.

However, he could not control the Spacetime Amber to mold it to the way he wanted it to be, so the amber he created would only be a ball.

Furthermore, the Spacetime Amber could only deflect energy attacks and not block them. If he wanted to use it on his mechanical suit, he would have to install it on a large area. Because it could not be molded, it was difficult to do so at the moment. He might have to form a Soul Connection with the Spacetime Amber before he could do so.

However, Han Xiao still had a way. The amber could be moved, and he planned to use the Spacetime Amber to create some amber balls that were larger than himself. He would then use the nano-shapeshifting hovering guards to wrap these amber balls. If he encountered an energy attack, he would use these amber balls as a shield to cover himself tightly. The effect might be even better than a tank talent.

"This can also be considered a special defensive method," Han Xiao thought to himself.

No wonder so many people fought for this Universal Treasure in his previous life. Not only was it a powerful imprisonment method, but it was also a blessing for brittleness.

Although the Spacetime Amber itself was not used for combat, as long as it was used properly, it could also have a miraculous effect. Its help in combat was even greater than the Evolution Cube.

After testing the actual effect, Han Xiao then used the Spacetime Amber to seal the Evolution Cube.

…

At the same time, on the mother planet of the Star Pupil Protoss …

"Black Star!"

Outside the door, the two guards standing guard suddenly heard the roar of their leader coming from the room. They were shocked and looked at each other.

In the room, Sisko's face was filled with shock and anger.

All along, although Sisko had lost the Evolution Cube, he did not seem anxious. His confidence came from the deep connection between his psychic power and the Evolution Cube. Even if the Evolution Cube was not in his hands, the psychic imprint left on the Evolution Cube would give him feedback at any time, increasing the strength of his psychic power.

This was just like how Black Star had only obtained the body of the Evolution Cube but not its heart. Sisko knew that the Evolution Cube still loved him.

Because he could determine the location of the Evolution Cube at any time, Sisko had always felt that the situation was still under his control.

However, just now, Sisko was shocked to find that his connection with the Evolution Cube had been cut off without any warning!

To him, it was like a wife who had to compromise with the enemy. However, the enemy had developed feelings for her and she had really fallen in love with someone else.

Psyker felt as if his heart was being attacked by a wave of anger. His heart was green, and it felt as if his family jewels had been kicked.
